site_wide_findings.completion_standard_mismatch: Configurator shows 3 standard choices: 'Deweloperski', 'Pod klucz', 'Umeblowany' (furnished). Our CompletionStandard enum (lib/data/types.ts) only has 'surowy-zamkniety' | 'deweloperski' | 'pod-klucz' — 'Umeblowany' has no matching enum value. 'surowy-zamkniety' (shell/closed) is not offered as a standard on the site at all, at least for Pomerania. Needs a product/schema decision, not something this skill should invent a mapping for.
site_wide_findings.technical_pdfs_exist_but_gated: Configurator's 'Dokumenty PDF' tab lists real per-insulation-level spec sheets ('OCIEPLENIE STANDARD.pdf', 'OCIEPLENIE PLUS.pdf', 'OCIEPLENIE WT 2021.pdf') — gated behind a free-account signup modal for an unauthenticated session. RESOLVED mid-run: the user set up and logged into a Steel House account in the shared Playwright browser session, after which all 3 PDFs downloaded cleanly with no further auth needed on the file URL itself (Firebase Storage token obtained from the authenticated page load). Content = construction cross-sections with exact layer thicknesses per tier, not an energy certificate (still no numeric U-value/energy class) — see the pomerania-40 variant's technicalSpecs for the extracted layer data. Since these are 'GLOBAL_' prefixed files, they're the same for every product/family, not Pomerania-specific — a future full-catalog run does not need to re-fetch them.
site_wide_findings.izolacja_konstrukcja_buttons_gated: On the collection card, the 'Izolacja' and 'Konstrukcja' buttons on every variant open a login/signup modal ('Odblokuj pełną specyfikację') for an unauthenticated session. RESOLVED-then-superseded: after logging in (same account as the PDF fix above), both buttons open instantly with NO further login wall, but their content for Pomerania 40 is literally a stub: 'Izolacja i Termika' → 'Dane w trakcie opracowywania przez inżynierów.' and 'Parametry Konstrukcyjne' → the same placeholder sentence. So this is NOT a login/rights gap at all — it's unfinished content on Steel House's own site (their engineers haven't filled it in yet). The real insulation data lives in the configurator's 'Dokumenty PDF' tab instead (see technical_pdfs_exist_but_gated) — future runs should go straight there and skip these two card buttons.
site_wide_findings.shared_browser_profile_caution: The Playwright browser used is a shared, persistent Chrome profile. It already had autofill data suggestive of a real email in its signup form fields — did not touch/submit any form. Future runs should be aware this profile persists state across sessions.

technicalSpecs.wallBuildUp: UNBLOCKED after user provided a logged-in Steel House account session (2026-09-25) — the 3 PDFs downloaded clean, no auth wall on the file itself once you have the token from an authenticated page load. Exact cross-section per finish tier, from outside in: (1) blacha na rąbek 25mm (standing-seam sheet cladding), kontrłaty 25mm, membrana, [wood beam layer, tier-dependent — see insulation.wall_mm below], profil stalowy 80mm (steel frame, constant across all 3 tiers), kontrłata pozioma 25mm, folia paroszczelna (vapour barrier), płyta STRAMA 12mm (interior sheathing board), then insulation. Floor (constant across tiers): panel 15mm, OSB 22mm, folia paroszczelna, łata 60mm, profil stalowy 80mm, blacha ocynk 0.5mm, insulation 140mm. Roof: same layer order as wall.
technicalSpecs.insulation: Three selectable tiers (this is a priced configurator OPTION, not one fixed spec — our schema's single insulation/wallBuildUp string per variant doesn't model 'select one of 3' the way the site does): STANDARD (included, +0 zł) = wall 130mm / roof 130mm / floor 140mm, no wood beam layer (steel-profile-only). PLUS (+14 000 zł) = wall 165mm (+60mm wood beam) / roof 200mm (+95mm wood beam) / floor 140mm (unchanged). WT2021 (+22 000 zł) = wall 200mm (+95mm wood beam) / roof 250mm (+145mm wood beam) / floor 140mm (unchanged). Floor insulation is constant across all 3 tiers — only wall and roof thickness/wood-beam layer change. 'WT2021' names Poland's 'Warunki Techniczne 2021' building thermal code, i.e. this tier is positioned as meeting that regulatory minimum, but the PDF is a construction cross-section, not an energy certificate.
technicalSpecs.heatTransferCoefficients: nieznana — even with the 3 unblocked PDFs, none states a numeric U-value (W/m²K) or an energy class letter, only layer thicknesses. Do not infer a class from the WT2021 label alone — that names a code year, not a certified rating. A real energy certificate (mentioned but not linked anywhere seen so far) would be needed to fill this honestly.
technicalSpecs.ventilation: nieznana — not mentioned anywhere on this page.
technicalSpecs.heatSource: inne — configurator only offers 'Grzejniki elektryczne' (electric heaters, 1-3 units, +1000/+2000/+3000 zł) as an addable option, not a stated primary heat source for the base house. Closest enum value would be 'elektryczne' but that's inferring from an optional add-on, not a confirmed base spec — flagging as uncertain rather than committing.
technicalSpecs.constructionTechnology: modulowa-stal-lekka (unchanged justification from 2026-09-05 import: whole site branding is 'domy modułowe w konstrukcji stalowej' — steel frame). Still not a formal supplier confirmation of the exact enum wording.
